newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada poultry sector sets export-specific deals.
newsitem.headline: Canada poultry sector sets export-specific deals.

text.p: Canada's quota-based poultry sector on Sunday implemented a national policy permitting processors and producers to sign contracts to supply specific export markets, a Chicken Farmers of Canada official said.
"It's a national policy that allows processors to request product for planned export purposes (to specific countries)," CFC spokeswoman Nicole Beauchamp said.
Export contracts have not been a option until Sunday when processors could contract supplies from specific countries.
Canada exported an estimated 31.7 million kgs of chicken in 1996 versus 33 million kgs in 1995, she said.
Canadian chicken production in the last eight week marketing period ended March 15 totalled 112.79 million kgs, figures show. Exports were not detailed.
About 2.37 million kgs of Canada's total chicken output of 116.1 million kgs from now to May 15 is set for export markets, Beauchamp said.
Canada exported chicken products to Russia, South Africa, Cuba and China in 1995, according to Statistics Canada.
